video.desc:
Waking up in the future President’s bed, the mafia don realized the escort he bought last night was no ordinary male hustler. As deadly secrets turn a paid thrill into raw obsession, are they bound for eternal bedtime secrets—or true love?

在未来总统的床上醒来时，黑帮教父才意识到，昨晚自己买下的那个男公关，绝非寻常货色。当致命的秘密将一场花钱买来的刺激变成赤裸裸的痴迷，等待他们的，是永远锁在床笫间的秘密——还是真爱？
